title: Cross-Layer Causality
reward: Learn to connect L3/L4/L7 and host evidence without confusing them.
knowledge: L3 answers reachability/source-network questions; L4 answers transport/connection questions; L7 answers request/application outcomes.
Host resource evidence adds capacity context but does not identify intent.
Security-control decisions describe what a control decided, not objective truth.
Layer agreement strengthens a causal hypothesis; disagreement should increase uncertainty.
Temporal order matters when proposing cause and consequence.
challenge: Build a causal chain spanning three evidence layers.
Identify one layer disagreement that should reduce confidence.
next_requires: Correlate independent layers and preserve causal uncertainty.
